name: Gooey Nav
description: Pill navigation bar whose active highlight is a WebGL liquid blob that stretches, merges and sheds droplets as it travels between items, inside an optional frosted glass frame.
contents: Nav with a list of link or button items, each with optional icon and label
Optional frosted rounded frame with rim highlight
WebGL2 canvas drawing the gooey active pill, droplets, hover pill and soft shadow
Hidden overlay list that shows the active item text in contrast color through the pill
behavior: Active pill morphs into the clicked item, spawning droplets that trail and merge with a metaball blend
Hover shows a soft pill behind the hovered item when hoverEffect is on
Supports uncontrolled (initialActiveIndex) or controlled (activeIndex with onChange) selection
Items with href render as anchors, others as buttons; href '#' or missing is prevented from navigating
Sets aria-current page on the active item
Remeasures on resize and after fonts load
Falls back to a plain CSS pill when WebGL2 is unavailable

props.name: items
props.default: Home, Work, About, Contact with href '#'

editableByProps: Menu items, labels, links and icons
Active item, controlled or uncontrolled, and change callback
Dark or light theme, pill color, active text color, droplet tint colors
Size sm, md or lg and frame on or off
Animation duration, variance, droplet count, spread, gooeyness, wobble and hover effect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change theme palette values such as frame glass or text colors
Change size dimensions or add new sizes
Change blob rendering, shading or rim light

fixed: Requires WebGL2 for the gooey effect, otherwise a simple flat pill is shown
Maximum 32 droplets and 4 simultaneous pills, higher particleCount is capped
Canvas extends 72px beyond the nav on all sides, so parent overflow hidden will clip the droplets
Colors accept only hex or rgb/rgba strings, other formats fall back to white
Marked as a client component and uses window, ResizeObserver and document.fonts
Wraps items when narrow, but the blob animation is designed for a single-row desktop-style bar
